name: telegram-bot
description: Set up a Telegram bot and prepare one alert. Use when you ask “create a Telegram bot”, “send this with my bot” or “can a bot read my chats?”. Gives setup steps and message drafts. A live send needs a separately available secure tool. Also helps review chat exports you have permission to process. Not for bulk outreach or a connection to your personal inbox. Includes no sending program, scheduler or service that keeps listening for updates.
